$Comment: What Santa packs for a player each time their favor on his Nice List climbs another step past Santa's
names this table, and its Every is the size of a step. Every roll is read on its own: the first always
pays and plays the moment Christmas_Santas_Sack (a toast and a sound), so the sack never lands
unannounced; the second is a chance on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. Festival tokens and
Christmas Coins pay through the Currency reward kind, since a counter wallet has no item to hand over.
Text names the reward on Santa's Reputation page and in the notice that pays it (Santa's Sack instead
of Loot Bundle) and gives its hover a line; the hover then lists what this table pays.
Name: Christmas_Santas_Sack
